question: Should OpenRouter music generation fail closed at the proposed 2 MiB pending SSE, 64 MiB decoded audio, and 1 MiB transcript limits, or should those thresholds be changed before merge?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow safety fix, but the exact fail-closed thresholds can reject outputs that existing releases attempted to buffer, so automation should not decide that compatibility tradeoff alone.

options.title: Accept current caps
options.body: Merge the provider-local caps as a memory-safety boundary and treat over-limit outputs as deterministic provider failures.

options.title: Adjust thresholds first
options.body: Ask the contributor to raise, document, or otherwise tune the caps before merge if maintainers expect larger legitimate OpenRouter music outputs.

options.title: Defer the branch
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want broader media-output limit policy before adding OpenRouter-specific caps.

recommendation.title: Accept current caps
recommendation.body: Merge the provider-local caps as a memory-safety boundary and treat over-limit outputs as deterministic provider failures.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the OpenRouter music generation feature and is the strongest owner signal for the provider behavior contract.
